Colleges are now selling bachelor’s degrees in content creation—because apparently starting a YouTube channel requires four years of tuition, general education credits, a mathematics placement test, and potentially hundreds of thousands of dollars.

Arizona State University’s new content creation degree promises to teach students podcasting, social media, storytelling, on-camera presence, editing, audience growth, and even “how to become an influencer.” For an out-of-state student, ASU estimates first-year expenses of roughly $64,00
